scope: Address arriving while an option (pendingAttribute) or a product list (pendingMatch) is open: the pending dish must survive and the option given with the address must be applied
baselineFindings: Address alone with an open option and an empty cart answered «Primero arma tu pedido» and dropped the pending dish
Option word plus address in one bubble («Limón\nCalle 10 # 5-20», «la de limón, calle …») stored everything as address or lost the option
Burst [address, option] lost the option; the grill family re-ask printed only the product card (prompt lacked hasAttributes)
With the agent on, an open product list was cleared by the non-pick branch when the address arrived
fix: splitPendingOptionFromAddress splits a multi-line message or burst into the single exact option of the open pendingAttribute (after stripping courtesy, articles and «gaseosa/bebida/sabor (de/que sea)») and an address-only remainder; the option runs first and the address continues as burstContinuation. splitBurstAtPendingAnswer runs first so «y otra de …» keeps its meaning. tryHandleAddressOnlyWhileBuildingCart no longer answers empty-cart while any pending choice is open and re-asks the option with hasAttributes. The pendingMatch non-pick branch keeps the list when the message is address-only.

second attribute of a two-attribute combo
address with an open product list
contrasts: two options in one message (no wrong split, no order)
